## PASTA 2.0.1

Wall geometry for the new maps, plus the walk-bot weapon automation fixes.

### Map geometry

- Added wall and visibility geometry for Cobblestone (`de_cbble`), Debris and El Dorado, so aimbot and triggerbot no longer shoot through walls on those maps.
- Map files are located in the package that actually contains them: stock `csgo/maps`, `csgo_community_addons`, a `maps/<map>.vpk` nested inside either one, and workshop archives.
- World physics and navigation meshes now load from whichever archive the map was found in, instead of assuming the outer map package holds them.
- The KV3 decoder reads the newer 32-bit zero/one node types that Cobblestone's physics data uses.

### Automation

- Weapon automation ownership is unified, so Auto Weapon Switch, Auto Bonus Weapon, Auto Knife and Auto Health Shot no longer fight over the same input.
- Auto Weapon Switch is available to the Walk Bot.
- Fixed Auto Weapon Switch ping-ponging when both weapons are empty, and Auto Bonus re-equipping a dry bonus weapon.

### Downloads

Download both files and keep them in the same folder:

- `pasta_loader.exe` — recommended launcher. Approve the UAC prompt, then press **Load PASTA**.
- `pasta.exe` — the assist itself. Start it this way if Counter-Strike 2 is already running.

PASTA makes no anti-cheat guarantee. Use it at your own risk.
